text:
The Kestrel plan (3–10 Nov) corrects configuration values for several modules and sets client requirements for webhooks, audit, media, backup, and cache. Rollout must follow three orders: webhooks before alerts, shipping before checkout, and indexer before notify.

Separation rules forbid dependency paths from archive to media and from alerts to gateway. Archive must not depend on upload, shipping must not depend on inventory, and checkout and tenant may never share a worker.

Four teams own the work: alpha (webhooks, search), beta (tenant, session, media), gamma (alerts, export), and delta (auth).

Several conditional couplings link settings across modules. Code review should take under a day. The security review is at month-end. The on-call rota and budget review move to next month, and no linter decision has been made.
